title: Roller Shutter Installation Limits
blurb: Safe installation sizes by shutter range, operator selection by door area, barrel diameters, flange thicknesses and shaft wall thicknesses.

blocks.text: This sheet sets the sizes a BossDoor roller shutter is built to. Every figure is a limit on the assembly, not on the slat alone: a curtain inside its limit but on an undersized barrel or an undersized shaft is outside it.
Widths are given as W, heights as C. All dimensions in metres unless marked otherwise.
The largest opening each slat section is rated to close. Past these sizes the curtain is a wide-span assembly and the governing load moves from the curtain weight to wind pressure on the closed face.
Operators are selected on door area. A blank means that range does not carry an operator for that area.
The operator is sized against the weighed curtain, not against the opening area, whenever the two disagree. Area is the quick check; weight is the specification.
The coiled curtain has to fit the headroom. Barrel diameter follows door height and pulley size. Dimensions in millimetres.
Flange thickness in millimetres, with the shaft and operator it is matched to. Door height in metres.
Wall thickness of the shaft by opening size and shaft diameter. A blank means that diameter is not used at that size.

items: KC.110 - for CD.100, CD.80 and BO.90A.
RS.100 - for CD.100, CD.80 and BO.90A.
KC.94E - for sections 69, 88, 57 and 55, where the 3rd-generation automatic latch with key release is fitted.
RS.85 - for sections 69, 88, 57 and 55, without the automatic latch.
76.GM - for sections 69, 88, 57 and 55, without the automatic latch.
RS.75 - for solid-slat curtains on an AC operator.
Receivers use a rolling code, so a captured transmission does not open the door a second time.
The matched controller works with the BossG InTel-SH.800 and BossG InTel-SH.1250 back-up units.
